final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM Customers c JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), shares AS (SELECT customer_count, 1.0 * customer_count / SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS share FROM state_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS overall_avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.customer_count) AS combined_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.overall_avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.overall_avg_share
